scenarios.drift_explanation: The source text singles out "Live Date" and requires that it have the meaning defined in Section 1.3, so this scenario violates the source. The IR only asserts that LiveDateTerm has that relation, but it does not express exclusivity or a broader quantifier over other terms, so it is silent about the scenario.

scenarios.description: The document says that "Live Date" will have the meaning defined in Section 1.3 only after Section 1.3 becomes effective, and before that time the term has no defined meaning.

The IR states only a static fact linking LiveDateTerm to Section1_3 and does not encode timing, effectiveness, or conditionality, so it cannot reject the scenario.
